title: Report whether installed coding-agent content is up to date — nlmixr2llm_status
text: Targets checked: * **Claude Code** (`~/.claude/` user scope `<path>/.claude/` project   scope) – discrete agent/skill files, compared content. * **Codex / `AGENTS.md`** (`~/.codex/AGENTS.md` `<path>/AGENTS.md`,   latter shared [install_agents_md()]). * **Positron** `agents.md` (`<path>/agents.md`) per-package   `*.instructions.md` files (`<path>/.github/instructions/`). Concatenated single-file targets carry embedded version stamp, compared package version recorded install time; Claude Code files compared content. file classified `"current"`, `"outdated"`, `"installed"`. targets actually installed content mentioned printed summary. package attached interactively, runs check automatically (read-) prints one-line notice installed copy date. Disable startup check `options(nlmixr2llm.startup_check = FALSE)`.

title: nlmixr2llm 0.1.0
text: Initial version. Ships single combined nlmixr2verse agent spanning nlmixr2 pharmacometrics ecosystem (rxode2, nlmixr2, nonmem2rx, monolix2rx, babelmixr2), plus one skill per package. Accessor functions: list_packages(), list_agents(), list_skills(), get_agent(), get_skill(), system_prompt() use system prompt LLM client. Installer functions write content locations expected Claude Code (install_claude_code()), OpenAI Codex CLI (install_codex()), Positron Assistant (install_positron()), tool reads AGENTS.md (install_agents_md()). Multi-file installers track write manifest can prune content package longer ships. nlmixr2llm_status() reports whether content installed target date package.
